meta.title: Wandit — AI landing pages that sell
meta.description: Wandit turns a prompt into a ready-to-run landing page — publish and collect COD orders in minutes.

hero.sub: Create your website, generate your ads, build your marketing strategy and launch your campaigns from one AI-powered platform.

proofBar.title: Everything you need to build, launch and grow your business.

problem.title: Launching a business should not take ten tools and a whole team.
roles: a developer to build the site
a designer to produce the visuals
an editor to make the videos
a marketer to build the strategy
a media buyer to run the campaigns
problem.resolution: With Wandit, you work with one AI that understands your business and orchestrates the whole process.

steps.title: Describe your idea
steps.body: Explain what you sell — in French, Arabic or English. Wandit understands your market and your product.

steps.title: Watch the AI build
steps.body: Your website, ad visuals and strategy are generated in front of you. Change anything with a simple message.

steps.title: Launch and sell
steps.body: Publish in one click, launch your campaigns and receive orders straight in your leads inbox.

demo.prompt: I sell mountain honey from the Aurès. Build my website, my ad visuals and my launch strategy.

meta.description: Start free, go Starter for $9, or Pro when you need more credits. Monthly or yearly.

pricing.title: Start small. Grow when you need more.
pricing.note: Publishing is always free. AI actions, including lead collection, use credits.

features: Upgrade when you need more AI work

features: Nine credit tiers as your workload grows

business.name: Business
business.tagline: For teams sharing one credit pool
features: One shared credit pool for the whole team
Unlimited seats — pay for credits, not people

items.a: Credits are Wandit's single currency. Every page build, image, video or chat edit uses credits. A short chat edit uses a fraction of a credit. A long page build uses more. Your balance shows what each run used.
Yes. Publishing your page and collecting leads never cost credits. You only spend when the AI works for you.

items.q: Do you support Arabic and RTL?
items.a: Fully. Prompt in Arabic and you get a native right-to-left page — layout, typography and order form included.
Every published page gets a your-page.wandit.app address on fast hosting. Custom domains are on the roadmap.

items.q: What happens when my credits run out?
items.a: Your published pages stay live and keep collecting orders. You just can't generate or edit until you top up.
